reuse.why: Reuses getNextDate's noSkipWeekend switch and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and adds one shared predicate isWeekendSkippedDaily used at all three sites.

duplication.why: The skip-or-move dispatch ('skipWeekend && !isWeekendSkipping ? move : date' plus a weekend filter) is re-written in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and twice in schedule-template's createScheduleList instead of living in one function.

placement.why: The predicate and cycle constant sit in shared/schedules.ts with the other recurrence helpers; frequency is threaded through parseRecurDate where schedule data is built.

scope.why: Only the daily-skip rule, its plumbing and tests.

maintainability.why: The 'daily' classification is central, but how skipping vs moving is applied is spread over four near-identical expressions that must be kept in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every weekend site uses isWeekendSkippedDaily and getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) re-expresses getNextDate's take-7/filter-weekend/move-otherwise logic as a map/filter/slice chain rather than sharing it.

one_place.where: isWeekendSkippedDaily in shared/schedules.ts decides which schedules skip; it is used by getNextDate, schedules/app getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template, though each site still applies skip vs move itself.
